title: quamoclit indivisa
intro: Quamoclit indivisa, commonly known as the ivy-leaved clematis or love vine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Quamoclit indivisa include sedative and anxiolytic properties, helping to alleviate stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
